scope: Offline command-model trajectories on two fixed candidate laws derived from initial real rendered sensor inputs. No physical reaching experiment, observation update, stiffness update, or gradient refresh occurs during these 30 seconds.
fixture: Rendered marker/IMU initial simultaneous compatibility fixture; stiffness Bayes-factor change recurrence explicitly disabled only for this fixture.

interpretation.relative_position_rms: sqrt(sum native_goal_weight*(norm(relative_position_mean-goal_offset)^2+trace(relative_position_covariance))); estimated candidate quantity, not physical tip error
interpretation.objective: Complete original frozen-law task J plus lambda times the complete native-mixture view penalty V, independently re-evaluated along the trajectory.
interpretation.curvature: Fixed source Fisher/GN approximation plus declared ridge; its stable stationary point is not an optimum of the nonlinear full criterion.
interpretation.constraint_stop: A proposed joint position outside the actual URDF box ends that trial. The proposed command is not executed or clipped; its last safe position and velocity are recorded.
interpretation.covariance_law: No candidate covariance, native mixture, body/goal cross block, or parameter density changes between the two execution models.
interpretation.diagnostic_queries: H reuses the 13 existing full-J source/probe evaluations. Further exact J/V queries are evaluation only and do not refresh the packet.
interpretation.trajectory_after_stop: The final CSV sample at the last safe model time contains the tracker halted velocity (zero). The motion velocity immediately before the stop is separately recorded in actual_stop.last_safe_velocity.

limitations: The two local-model trials stay within the joint box for these 30 seconds; this does not guarantee another law, delayed packet switch, or live physical motion will do so.
The exact nonlinear selected objective is not monotone: it rises again after its early minimum even with the stable fixed SPD model.
The IMU+marker local-model estimated relative RMS increases from its initial value by 30 seconds.
No claim of physical arrival, live stability, collision safety, or updated-source performance follows from this fixed-law fixture.
The residual-GN design alternative was compared but is not implemented as an additional production method.

rejected_residual_GN_design_comparison.note: Weak-ridge stationary commands were inside the joint box in all four initial fixtures, but this did not demonstrate superior reaching or selected-objective performance. The production method remains Fisher.

reproduction.raw_scene_full_json_and_csv_destination: Only the explicit user-selected output directory; full comparison JSON is not included in this repository summary.
reproduction.rounding_note: The generalized tool uses the remaining interval for its final partial step; floating subtraction can change the final default step by about 1e-15 seconds. Reported differences are float64 arithmetic, not a different law or gain.
